title: Akiyama Mizuki — Summer Night Festival〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm beat...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It felt like they made me do a year's worth of studying today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I could stop by a cafe for a sweet reward...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? That voice... Toya?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I guess he's in the middle of singing practice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But he just practiced this morning. He's back at it again?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: He's so serious about it too. I guess he just really loves to sing, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I probably shouldn't bother him right now. Plus, I'm exhausted from school, so let's get home...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A-Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: H-Hey, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He came out of nowhere! What is it with me running into people today?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Or maybe I should've expected this since he's probably here to practice with Toya at the park!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're in your uniform. Were you at school today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, yeah. Supplementary classes, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you here to meet up with Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, how'd you know? Did you see him?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I saw him on my way to school after you guys just finished your morning practice. I even saw him in the park just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you guys here to meet up and do another practice together, Li'l Bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We're meeting as a team and heading over to an event right after.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Wait, does that mean An and Kohane are coming too?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they are... Hold on, you know about Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
An's told me all about her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I even got to meet her during the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, alright.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's kinda weird to think that you're singing with them, Li'l Bro...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, this all sort of just happened, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We found ourselves singing all together this one time, and something just clicked.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Us all having the same dream helped too, probably.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, An told me about that too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something about putting on an event that's better than the one An's dad put on, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's so cool.
You guys really are all working towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you've been making music with Ena and some others, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha... Sure, but that's just something we're doing for ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong with that? I see no problem with what you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A little while ago, Ena looked like she was headed for a dark place. To be fair, it was sort of our dad's fault...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But before I knew it, she was completely over it and drawing again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys did something to help her get through that, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's bothered by the dumbest things and always sounds like she's picking a fight, so she's never really had a lot of friends.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because of that, she directs most of her anger toward me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So I'm glad that she met someone like Momoi and formed a group with you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I never knew...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena...
Sometimes I think you're the older sibling, Li'l Bro.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But hasn't she been making you do a lot of stuff for her too, lately?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, you two have been going out shopping or to cafes a lot, it seems.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I-It does?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, that has to be because I've been making her worry about me...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ena hardly ever returns favors...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you might want to find a way to make her return some favors somehow while you still have a chance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Huh? Wait...
This feels like déjà vu...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If there's something bothering you, Mizuki, I think you should talk to Ena about it. I'm sure she can help you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, right. That time...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Akiyama? You there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, don't worry. I was listening.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But the Ena I know isn't as bad you say she is, Li'l Bro...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The Ena I know does actually care about others and can't leave anyone she thinks needs help alone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seriously♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And aren't you gonna be late for practice?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll be going then!
Bye bye♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Ena messaged me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm heading out to get this new lipstick I found. Wanna come with...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She really can't leave me alone, can she?
